scope: Persistent container ownership enforced by node inventory and lifecycle operations, beyond Manager list coalescing.
implementation: Creation uses a shared filesystem reservation and refuses existing container directories.
Owner is atomically claimed in .ibhics-owner.json and retained in existing settings metadata for NFS negative lookup compatibility.
A non-owner does not list the container and cannot get, start or delete it.
Legacy running containers register their actual runtime host; legacy stopped containers require verified Manager assignment before node lifecycle operations.
Ownership survives stopped state, new backend instances, rename and pool move; conflicting or unreadable metadata fails closed.

production_acceptance.stop_via_manager: 200; one stopped inventory entry remained on ibhics-node2
production_acceptance.non_owner_104: Native backend get/start/delete all rejected while stopped; rootfs preserved; native inventory empty

limitations: Ownership is not automatically transferred to another node on host failure; an explicit future relocation protocol must verify the previous owner is no longer running.
